bug_semantics: module_34301.c (KeePass AESKDF / KDBX v4) tokenizes hash-line field 9 (header) with len_min=400 and len_max=600 hex characters, then hex_decode()s the token into keepass4->header[64] (256 bytes) with no size check. A maximal 600-hex token decodes to 300 bytes and writes 44 bytes past the header field; 8 of those bytes leave the 328-byte keepass4_t esalt into adjacent heap-chunk metadata, causing heap corruption or SIGSEGV when hashcat parses an attacker-supplied hash file.
flaw_origin: The overflow was first written when module_34301.c was added. The sibling Argon2 module 34300 used a fixed 506-hex header token (253 decoded bytes) that fits header[64]. The new AESKDF decoder copied the same 256-byte header but widened field 9 to a 400–600 hex range, with an in-file comment that AESKDF headers are ~414 hex / 207 bytes versus 507 hex for Argon2, and performed an unbounded hex_decode into header[64]. A later line_len<128 check (bc33157) does not bound token[9].

reasoning: CVE-2026-68765 is a real, vendor-reproduced heap overflow in the KeePass AESKDF module, not a withdrawn or rejected advisory. The sink is module_hash_decode in src/modules/module_34301.c: field 9 is allowed up to 600 hex characters and decoded into a 256-byte header[64] with no length check, so a crafted hash line overflows the esalt allocation. git log -S and the new-file diff show that this 600-hex bound and unbounded hex_decode were first written in ef52453de9523f6a010652847b61cb340ed5daa5 ("implement keepass4 aeskdf"), which added module_34301.c. The immediate parent 9212532dec54a286cf3b8bac281bb6fa26e540aa has neither the file nor the 600 bound; the pre-existing 34300 decoder used a fixed 506-hex header that fits the 256-byte buffer, so this is a first write of the overflowing bound rather than a move, refactor, or copy of an already-overflowing token limit. The commit is a regular single-parent object in public history (later merge PR #4471), so it is the BIC; squash_decomposed is false. A later line_len<128 guard does not close the token[9] path. The fix that does close it landed as squash 6f374c4ff7d5dc951530fbbbcf6b45e3c169b100 from PR #4755, with identical patch-id on PR head 34ed9220e90b0d1c3b361d436abb213a15449be9; BIC precedes that fix and is after v7.1.2, matching the published git affected range.
